## History

Longfellow is a figure from Captain Jim's past who is remembered in connection to his tragic history. While comforting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over her lost child, Captain Jim shares the story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and his enduring memories of her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P2](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P3](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P4](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P5](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P6](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P7](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0007), +10 more_
